Plot Bayesian flood frequency curve with extended NVE-style uncertainty

Source: R/custom_functions.r
fx.plot.quantile.curve.base.Rd

This version expands the lower-tail plotting-position uncertainty by clamping probabilities \(p \le 0\) to an extremely small positive value (\(10^{-30}\)), allowing the uncertainty bars to extend much further left, consistent with NVE's Hydra/FlomQ implementation. Ascending ranks are used for uncertainty, and no lower-bound filtering is applied to the resulting return periods. The upper tail is also clamped to \(1 - \varepsilon\) to avoid premature truncation.

Usage

fx.plot.quantile.curve.base(
  analysis,
  T.start = 1.01,
  T.end = 1000,
  plotting.formula = 0.44,
  add = FALSE,
  label = NULL,
  show.pp.uncertainty = TRUE,
  eps = 0
)

Arguments

analysis

Output from perform.analysis().

T.start

Minimum return period for the posterior curve.

T.end

Maximum return period for the posterior curve.

plotting.formula

Plotting-position constant for observed points.

add

If TRUE, add to an existing plot.

label

Legend label.

show.pp.uncertainty

If TRUE, draw plotting-position uncertainty bars.

eps

Small positive value for probability clamping.

Value

A plot is produced as a side effect.
